title: Wet Fart
blurb: Every soundboard eventually arrives at the high-risk branch of the taxonomy, and here it is. Where the classic fart is innocent slapstick, this one carries clear implications, and every listener works them out within about a tenth of a second — that flicker of hesitation is the entire joke. It explains why the wet variant is the connoisseur's pick for prank videos and fail-compilation punctuation: it does not merely interrupt a moment, it adds a plot. Reach for it when a regular fart simply is not disrespectful enough for what is happening on screen. Consequences implied, never shown.
